description: Advances: bw.signal.pipeline. Hooks run with cwd = repo root (commondir parent). When bw signal emit runs from a linked worktree, gate hooks that verify the tree (compile/test) silently operate on the primary checkout instead of the emitting worktree, and ancestry checks against HEAD see the wrong branch. Verified empirically. Fix: export the invocation directory (repo.CWD) as BW_SIGNAL_CALLER_CWD in the hook environment so worktree-aware gates can cd into the tree under test. Hook cwd stays repo root per bw.decision.signal_hook_io.
title: Expose caller cwd to signal hooks as BW_SIGNAL_CALLER_CWD
